story.originalTitle: You saw it at Comic Con, now see it in our Austin Fan Zone 🇺🇸👊 This special Marvel livery is coming to the show car in the Austin Fan Zone - ...
story.summaryEn:
You saw it at Comic Con, now see it in our Austin Fan Zone 🇺🇸👊
This special Marvel livery is coming to the show car in the Austin Fan Zone - we can't wait for you to see it in person! 💙
detailZh:
你在动漫展上看到了它，现在在我们的奥斯汀粉丝区也能看到🇺🇸👊
这款特别的漫威涂装即将出现在奥斯汀粉丝区的展示车辆上——我们迫不及待地想要让你亲眼看到它！💙
detailEn:
You saw it at Comic Con, now see it in our Austin Fan Zone 🇺🇸👊
This special Marvel livery is coming to the show car in the Austin Fan Zone - we can't wait for you to see it in person! 💙

relatedItems.titleZh: 威廉姆斯车队卡洛斯晋级Q2，亚历克斯止步Q1

relatedItems.originalTitle: Carlos is through to Q2 in P16 ⏰ That’s the end of Alex’s qualifying as he finishes in P17.

detailZh: 卡洛斯是威廉姆斯车队的车手，他在排位赛中成功晋级到Q2，位列第16位。而亚历克斯，同样是威廉姆斯车队的车手，他的排位赛到此结束，最终排名第17位。
detailEn:
Carlos is through to Q2 in P16 ⏰
That’s the end of Alex’s qualifying as he finishes in P17.
